contract: rank_crystals(unrelaxed_structures, budget) -> exactly budget unique integer indices. Structures are evaluator-provided pre-relaxation crystal records, with optional target-free descriptors; labels remain private. Score precision of DFT energy-above-reference-hull <=0 eV/atom among selected candidates. Training MP and evaluation WBM chemistry/structure groups must be disjoint; no claim of experimental synthesis.
